_README: Source -> political classification. KEY = substring of the feed title (case-insensitive), VALUE = score -2..+2 OR an object for non-Western/state sources. This _README key is ignored (no feed is named like this).
_scale: -2 = left, -1 = center-left, 0 = center, +1 = center-right, +2 = right. The classification is subjective - adjust to your own assessment.
_second_dimension: State/non-Western media don't fit on the left-right axis. Instead of a number, an object: { score, kind, alignment }. score:null = left/right n/a. kind = state-controlled | state-funded | independent-nonwestern. alignment = free detail tag (tooltip only).
_note: The names below are generic placeholders - replace them with the actual feed titles of your own sources.
